title: PV Design Engineer
description: Preparation of 2D/3D solar layout designs in AutoCAD, string sizing, shadow analysis, and PVsyst energy yield simulation for C&I rooftop and MW-scale utility solar plants.

title: Safety Officer
description: Enforcing zero-compromise HSE policies, job safety analysis (JSA), electrical safety lock-out tag-out (LOTO), working-at-height controls, and safety tool audits on EPC sites.

title: Project Manager
description: End-to-end execution of turnkey industrial rooftop and ground-mounted solar plants, DISCOM net-metering approvals, vendor coordination, contractor management, and commissioning timelines.

title: Site Engineer
description: On-site civil foundation supervision, module mounting structure (MMS) alignment, DC/AC cabling, string inverter termination, and daily progress reporting (DPR).

title: Site Supervisor
description: Direct supervision of site workforce, material tracking, structural torque checking, electrical conduit routing, and strict adherence to engineering drawings.

title: Site Coordinator
description: Liaison between head office engineering, site teams, and logistics partners for dispatch scheduling, material delivery verification, and compliance paperwork.

title: Cluster Manager
description: Managing multi-site EPC project portfolios across assigned regional clusters, tracking milestone billing, DISCOM grid synchronizations, and team allocation.

title: Quality Engineer
description: In-process quality inspections, IV curve tracer testing, thermal imaging, grounding resistance audits, Tier-1 module quality checks, and FAT/SAT certifications.

title: O&M Engineer
description: 24/7 solar plant performance monitoring via SCADA IoT gateways, scheduled thermography, robotic/manual module washing cycles, preventive maintenance, and PR improvement.

title: Senior Technician
description: Hands-on electrical installations, HT/LT panel terminations, transformer oil testing, earth pit maintenance, and high-voltage breaker commissioning.

title: Intern Technician
description: Apprenticeship under senior field engineers learning solar PV layout, module stringing, DC crimping, multimeter testing, and safety protocols.

title: Support Staff
description: General office upkeep, documentation archiving, facility management, and logistics support for corporate and field operations.

title: Accountant
description: EPC vendor ledger reconciliation, GST compliance, Tally ERP entries, client billing, TDS filing, and project-wise cost accounting.

title: Sales Manager
description: Driving multi-megawatt commercial & industrial (C&I) solar EPC sales, consulting industrial leaders on Capex/Opex solar returns, and leading high-performing sales teams.

title: Back Office Executive
description: Data entry, preparing techno-commercial quotes, updating CRM leads, DISCOM portal applications, and coordinating documentation with engineering teams.

title: Telecaller
description: Connecting with prospective commercial rooftop clients, explaining government subsidies under PM Surya Ghar and industrial solar savings, and setting engineering audit visits.

title: Social Media Manager
description: Managing corporate presence across LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube. Creating engaging site reels, milestone project showcases, award ceremonies, and thought-leadership posts.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description: SEO optimization, Google Ads campaigns for clean energy leads, performance tracking, landing page CRO, and local search visibility across North Indian industrial zones.

title: Office Coordinator
description: Managing daily office flow, front desk, travel arrangements for field engineers, client visit hospitality, and procurement of internal supplies.

title: Business Development Manager
description: Expanding Sor Connect's client footprint in industrial sectors like marble processing, textiles, pharmaceuticals, and cold storage across Rajasthan, Gujarat, and UP.

title: HSE Officer
description: Conducting daily safety toolbox talks, hazard identification, emergency preparedness drills, environmental compliance audits, and personal protective equipment (PPE) enforcement.

title: Purchasing Manager
description: Procurement of Tier-1 solar modules (Reliance, Waaree, Adani), string inverters (Sungrow, Hitachi), MMS structures, DC cables, and negotiating best vendor lead times.

title: Technician
description: Electrical wiring, string combining, earthing electrode installation, lightning arrestor setups, and inverter terminal connections.

title: Sr. Engineer
description: Senior electrical engineering oversight, single line diagram (SLD) sign-offs, grid synchronization studies, HT transformer protection, and CEIG statutory clearances.

title: Junior Technician
description: Assisting on site for module mounting, cable tray routing, DC connector crimping, and pre-commissioning continuity testing.

title: Regional Manager
description: Leading regional operations, project governance, key client relationship management, and state DISCOM liaison for rapid net-metering sanctions.

title: Sales Representative
description: Field outreach to commercial and residential property owners, evaluating rooftop space, explaining tariff reduction, and closing turnkey solar proposals.

title: Sales Support
description: Preparing technical proposals, ROI payback schedules, client pitch decks, and coordinating site visit schedules with field engineers.

title: Installer & Fabricator
description: On-site mechanical fabrication, elevated superstructure mounting, hot-dip galvanized steel torqueing, ballasted foundation placement, and module clamping.

title: HR Executive
description: Candidate screening, interview scheduling, engineer onboarding, technical skills assessment coordination, employee welfare, and field team payroll support.

title: Site Incharge
description: Overall on-site responsibility for commissioning safety, material security, contractor coordination, daily civil & electrical inspection, and client handovers.
